1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

The ÄKTA Pure chromatography run was executed using an automated workflow consisting of a manual loading step followed by an instrument-controlled protocol.

3.1 Workflow Overview
  1. Manual Sample Loading
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop".
    • The operator manually filled the ÄKTA sample loop with the prepared sample.
  2. ÄKTA Pure Protocol Execution
    • The ÄKTA Pure system was started in automated mode to execute the predefined protocol.
    • Sample signals recorded included UV absorbance (uv1) and conductivity (cond) with a sampling time of 1 second.
3.2 Run Parameters

The following parameters were used for the chromatography run (where applicable to the selected method):

Parameter Placeholder Description
Process ID [[PROCESS_ID]] Unique identifier of the automated process/workflow.
Equilibration Duration [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Duration of column equilibration before loading.
Equilibration Flow Rate [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during column equilibration.
Load/Inject Duration [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Total time used for sample loading/injection onto the column.
Load/Inject Flow Rate [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate applied during sample loading/injection.
Elution Gradient Duration [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Total duration of the elution gradient.
Elution Gradient Start [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting percentage of the strong eluent (e.g. buffer B) in the gradient.
Elution Gradient End [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final percentage of the strong eluent (e.g. buffer B) in the gradient.
Wash Duration [[WASH_DURATION]] Duration of the post-elution wash step.
Wash Flow Rate [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during the wash step.
CIP Duration [[CIP_DURATION]] Total duration of the column cleaning-in-place (CIP) step.
CIP Step 2 Hold Duration [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold time during the second CIP step.
CIP Step 3 Duration [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of the third CIP step.
CIP Step 4 Duration [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of the fourth CIP step.
CIP Step 5 Duration [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of the fifth CIP step.
